{{Quote|I'm hereby informing you, therefore, that I will be returning to Wayland &hellip; and will be assuming command of your Mount Tantiss project.''"<br />"''The Mount Tantiss project?''"<br />"''Yes. Oh, I know about it, Captain. Despite your petty efforts to conceal the truth from me.|[[Joruus C'baoth]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="DFR" />}}
The '''Mount Tantiss project''' was a secret [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] project carried out by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|reemergence]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. With the ranks of Imperial military personnel, including [[Officer/Legends|officers]], [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], drained by [[Imperial Civil War|conflicts]] between Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], Thrawn set out to find new ways to regain the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military strength]] the Empire once had. After discovering a [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|secret storehouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] established by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Thrawn was able to add thousands of [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s to remake new personnel.

Thrawn was able to select several [[Clone template/Legends|genetic templates]], from the legendary [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]],<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Creb]] the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Black Wing Squadron]], the ruthless [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Terkuss]],<ref name="TTTS" /> and possibly the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|famed]] Imperial hero [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]].<ref name="NEGtC" /> Thrawn also attempted to create a super-[[Commando/Legends|commando]], selecting [[Grodin Tierce]] as a perfect subject. Thrawn desired a soldier with his tactical brilliance as well as honed physical ability, but ultimately left the project after losing hope in its success.<ref name="VotF" />
